paragraphs.text: Jed MacKay (1983) is a Canadian comic book writer.

MacKay grew up in Stanley Bridge, Prince Edward Island, and now lives in Halifax, Nova Scotia. He is best known for writing for Marvel Comics , specifically Black Cat . For BOOM! Studios he writes the (non-canon) Magic: The Gathering BOOM! comics .
He’s not the other Canadian Jed MacKay , that’s the Just For Laughs theme song guy.
